name: linear-devotee
description: Linear orchestration for Codex with complete AC-traceable issue packets, dependency-aware ready-work selection, validated implementation plans, and explicit mutation gates.

interface.shortDescription: Plan and create Linear work from Codex
interface.longDescription: Linear Devotee bundles Codex skills for detecting Linear issues, producing SDD briefs, setting work in progress, planning implementation with exhaustive AC coverage, recommending the next dependency-ready issue, and creating Linear project cascades. Complete issue bodies, stable AC references, and blockers are previewed before one approval gate; no issue content is generated during mutation. Linear writes stay behind explicit confirmation except the documented In Progress flip during greet.
defaultPrompt: Use Linear Devotee to brief this Linear issue before implementation.
Use Linear Devotee to create a project, milestones, and issues from this spec.
Use Linear Devotee to recommend the next issue after this one is done.
